peculiarities:
ஃ is called ஆய்தம் (aaytham). It is neither a soul letter nor a body letter: it stands on its own, between the two families.

It is a soft breath, a gentle 'hh' from the back of the throat. It never begins a word; it sits between a short vowel and a hard consonant, as in எஃகு (ekku, steel).

Its shape is three dots, like three snakes curled up to rest. Some call it the 'third eye' letter.
